intro: Gentlemen, Gameweek 7. Brighton beat Crystal Palace 5-0 and Arsenal won 1-0 at Forest. Man City edged Ipswich 3-2 and Spurs beat Coventry 3-1. Ben top-scored with 70 points. Asher scored 31, the lowest of the eight. Nobody moved in the table, which is stability of a sort. Ben leads on 378, Asher is second on 336 and Jonny third on 325. Jamie is last on 248, which is a long way from the others.
motw: Ben, 70 points. Kostoulas, Vuskovic, Tavernier and Konsa all made the team of the week. That is four of the eleven from one squad. Suzuki added 8 in goal. He now leads Asher by 42 points. The rest of you are playing for second.
stinker: Asher, 31 points. De Cuyper, White and Kudus managed 6 each. Martinez sat on the bench with 8, which was more than any of his starters scored. Asher stays second, but that was a poor week.
bench: Jamie left 23 points on the bench. Neto scored 15 with two goals and Jamie did not start him. Neto is in the team of the week, and his owner was not there to see it. Hall added 4 on the bench too. Jamie is last, so the timing was poor.
bench_jam: Louie's Bassey came on for Sávio and scored 8, with a clean sheet for Fulham. The auto-sub did the job without being asked. Sávio's slot was filled by a defender, and Louie collected the points. Neat.
red_card: Josh's Schade scored 0 in 45 minutes for Brentford. He picked up a yellow card and Brentford conceded twice. Brentford lost 2-1 to Liverpool, so Josh's Becker still managed 2 in the other goal. Schade did not come back for the second half.
gloves: Asher's Donnarumma scored 1 point. Man City conceded twice against Ipswich, and he made one save. Haaland scored two for Louie in that same game. Asher's keeper helped Louie's forward, and the group chat will notice.
